rows.title: Walu
notes: “I want to wrap up my show with a track called Walu by Wiradjuri artist Chloe”

Wiradjuri producer's track 'Wahluu' (named for Mount Panorama) from debut EP 'homebody'; presenter's 'Walu' is a near-homophone, and the FBi 'Independent Artist of the Week' feature ties her directly to the station.
